agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: The ear is ripe and dawn still takes two corn no matter how careful we are. Leaving a full row standing while the bin only shrinks is how a careful farm goes hungry.
today.expect: Corn in storage and an empty field before the ration can outrun the crop.

yesterday.why: We spent eight on the field yesterday. Water is the constraint that ends farms, and a cistern that only goes down is how that story starts.
yesterday.expect: Cistern refilled enough that another clear day is not a gamble.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve. The second the ear comes off, the next row goes in — heat does not wait for an empty sack.
today.expect: A seeded row catching tomorrow's moisture while the harvest sits in the bin.

yesterday.why: The ditch is cut. Heat does not wait, and watering through a new cut is the first proof it holds.
yesterday.expect: The growing row gets a ditch-boosted soak so moisture stays well above twenty.
